issue.description:
ADR-001 (accepted 2026-08-12) decides a third dependency kind `verifies` that lets an author declare a check relationship, plus structural diagnosis of inverted verification gates, and marks it as post-0.1 item R025 — but no open bead tracks any of it. Add the `verifies` edge kind alongside `blocks` in the dependency graph; diagnose 'a blocks edge whose blocker verifies its blocked bead' as an inversion; keep the diagnosis advisory-only and never reject the edge at insert time; never infer the relationship from issue titles. Wire the declaration into the R023 `why` explanation where useful. Cover with conformance tests (acyclic inverted pairs are detected and reported; deliberate baseline-gate orderings are not rejected), and update §3.4 documentation, help text, JSON Schema/field guide, and checkpoint round-trip for the new kind.

Created by: weave strand

issue.close_reason:
R025 is already implemented and complete on main — no file changes were needed from this dispatch, and this close records verification of that shipped state rather than new work. Every acceptance clause holds at HEAD 99502148. Migration 18 widens the dependencies.kind CHECK to the three-kind vocabulary (blocks, relates_to, verifies). is_valid_kind accepts exactly those three and fails closed on unknown kinds. The cycle DFS follows blocks edges alone, so verifies rings are legal and an inverted blocks-plus-verifies pair is accepted at insert time. Doctor emits the advisory inverted_verification_gates warning naming each (blocked, blocker) pair with a reason_code and the exact dep remove remedy, derived from a structural SQL join over declared edges — issue titles are never read. The checkpoint round trip is pinned by verifies_edge_round_trips_through_checkpoint. Spec section 3.4, help text, man pages, the schema enum, capabilities, why, and dry-run all carry the three-kind vocabulary. Because new source landed after the SHA a prior attempt verified (0e815d8) — checkpoint extensions plus two interchange suites — the FULL definition of done was re-run, not the --fast gate, in a clean git-archive extraction of HEAD at /var/tmp/bead-r025-verify, where fmt, clippy -D warnings, and cargo test all passed with 109 suites ok and zero failures. The shared working tree was never used for verification because it carries another worker in-flight extensions edit in src/store/migrations.rs that is not part of HEAD. The extraction was removed after success, and the four pending fleet checkpoint bookkeeping revisions were pushed so origin/main matches HEAD (rev-list origin/main..HEAD is empty).

issue.description:
ADR-001 is Accepted with measured field evidence (21 and 24 inverted verification gates across two live workspaces), but no implementation bead exists and the shipped model still constrains dependency kind to blocks|relates_to. Implement post-0.1 item R025: add a third dependency kind `verifies`; extend §3.4 validation, serialization, and checkpoint round trips for it; and add an advisory doctor diagnosis that reports a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead, naming the edge and the exact remedy. Never infer the relationship from issue titles and never reject the edge at insert time. Cover with round-trip and concurrency tests, plus spec, help, and schema documentation updates.

Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
